description: HP Appendix B: one schema per frame type with the lane, the type byte and the class. The type bytes are pinned here (steward ruling R-4). A frame payload is one JSON object that also carries the connection epoch.

instance.description: An opaque instance id used for fencing and logs (HP section 2).

Hello.description: Hub to plugin: the first frame on lane 0 (HP HS-1, LD-2, A2-25).

Epoch.description: HP WF-3, MD-4: a u64; a JSON integer up to 2^53, a decimal string above.

Grant.description: A grant: a surface and an optional scope (HP section 3, HS-1, MN-2).

PluginLimits.description:
The limits that the Hub chooses per plugin and sends in `Hello` (HP section 15, LM-1).

Numeric fields are u64. `lanes`, `probe_text`, `session_port_range` and the address and path parameters have their own types.
The five Core service protections and `instruction_budget` are optional: a protection that Core cannot apply is reported, not set (HP section 15).

LaneLimits.description: The four lanes, by name (HP section 2).

LaneBound.description: The lane bounds of `lanes[lane] = {frames, bytes}` (HP section 15, SV-3).

provider.description: `null` for an unmet optional binding (HP HS-1, PD-5, PD-8); an absent key is accepted as well (A2-25).

HelloBinding.description: A resolved interface binding (HP HS-1, PD-5, A2-25). `provider` is absent for an unmet optional one.

Priority.description: A priority name and its rank (HP EV-11, A2-25). v1: `high` 2, `normal` 1, `low` 0.

entity_providers.description: Entity family declarations (HP EN-1). The contract states no field names beyond EN-1's list; see `entities`.

Ready.description: Plugin to Hub: the proposed registration (HP HS-2, Appendix B, A2-25).

HandlerDecl.description: A handler registration: id, kind and descriptor (HP HS-2, IV-8, A2-5). The descriptor body depends on the kind; see `handlers`.

HandlerKind.description: The kind of a handler, as a wire string (HP A2-5). A kind outside this set fails closed (HP VR-4).

callable_by.description: `["plugins"]` opts in to plugin calls (HP PC-1).

ToolDecl.description: An MCP tool registration (HP MT-1, PC-1). The contract states these fields; other keys are accepted.

PromptDecl.description: An MCP prompt registration (HP MT-1). Other keys are accepted.

ResourceDecl.description: An MCP resource registration (HP MT-1, A2-5 descriptor). Other keys are accepted.

gap_handler.description: The handler id of the `event_gap` handler (HP EV-15).

EventsDecl.description: The events section of `Ready` and of the manifest (HP HS-2, MN-3, EV-15).

keyed.description: The event may carry a coalescing `key` (HP EV-13, MN-3). Present in the manifest entry.

DeclaredEvent.description: An event a plugin declares that it emits (HP EV-1, MN-3, Appendix B). `priority` is a name of `Hello.priorities` (default `normal`).

StateSource.description: The `state_source` of an event declaration (HP EV-1, EV-12, MN-3).

EventPattern.description: The `{owner, name}` pattern of a subscription (HP EV-2).

SubjectsScope.description: Which sessions a subscription covers (HP EV-2, CP-4).

EntityFamilyDecl.description:
A declared entity family (HP EN-1). `kind` is the family name in the plugin's own namespace, `schema_version` is `M.m`.
EN-1 names `actions` ("argument and result schemas and required permissions") without field names, so each action is an open object.
Other keys are accepted: the contract states no more fields here.

TimerDecl.description: A timer to re-arm (HP HS-2, CA-12, A2-25, A2-53).

WatchDecl.description: A store watch to re-arm (HP HS-2, ST-6, A2-14, A2-25, A2-53).

FsWatchDecl.description: A filesystem watch to re-arm (HP FS-3, A2-25). `handler_id` is mandatory.

SessionActionMap.description: The action-to-handler mapping of a contributed session action (HP VW-8, A2-25).

OperationsDecl.description: The operation-completion subscription (HP CA-16, A2-5): the handler of kind `operation` that receives it.

optional.description: Only on a capability the plugin can do without (HP CP-8, MN-1).

Capability.description: A manifest capability (HP MN-1, MN-2, NT-2, CP-8). Also the entry of `Ready.grants`. `allow` is only on surface `net` (HP MN-1): the decoder and the schema refuse it elsewhere.

HostInfo.description: The host facts of `Ready` (HP HS-2, LH-2, LH-4).

Features.description: The feature names a plugin needs (HP HS-4). The two sets are distinct names.

Activated.description: Hub to plugin: the Hub published the registration (HP HS-2). The payload is the epoch only.

Shutdown.description: Hub to plugin: orderly stop or refused registration (HP LD-4, HS-2). `reason` is a typed reason string.

Fault.description: Plugin to Hub, or Hub to plugin for an unknown frame: the host cannot continue (HP CR-2, VR-2).

Cancel.description: Hub to plugin: cancel one invocation (HP IV-5).

WireId.description:
An opaque id as it crosses the wire: a JSON integer in range, or a decimal string (HP WF-3, section 3 `RequestId`, `CallId`).
The form is kept, so an id echoes back exactly as it was sent.

descriptor_id.description: The opaque descriptor identity, revalidated at dispatch (HP IV-8).

Invoke.description: Hub to plugin: run one handler (HP IV-1, Appendix B).

Caller.description: Who asked (HP section 7, VC-1). A kind outside this set fails closed (HP VR-4).

Origin.description: HP VC-5, A2-5: how the handler was reached. Non-exhaustive; an unknown string is opaque.

EventSourceRef.description: The source of an event invocation (HP VC-7, EV-9).

SourceKind.description: The kind of an event source (HP EV-9).

ResultFrame.description: Plugin to Hub: the handler finished (HP IV-2). The frame type is named `Result` on the wire.

PluginResult.description: HP section 3, section 14. Descriptive extension fields are accepted and ignored (HP section 18, VR-3); an `error` in a successful result and a `value` in a failed result are refused.

ErrorBody.description: The body of a failure (HP section 14, ER-2, ER-5). `effect` is set where the caller sees the failure; a plugin's own `Result` may omit it, because the Hub adds it (HP section 2, ER-5).

ErrorKind.description: HP section 14, ER-1: the closed set of kinds. A reader treats an unknown string as `failed`.

Effect.description: Whether a mutating call had an effect (HP CA-5, ER-5).

Detail.description:
The `detail` of an error (HP section 14, ER-3). `code` is the stable specific code; `reason` is the closed reason of a state refusal (A2-2).
Other keys carry the descriptive fields that individual clauses name (for example `names`, `op_index`, `status`); the contract states them per clause.

HostCall.description: Plugin to Hub: ask the Hub to do one operation (HP CA-1).

CallContext.description:
The context of a host call: exactly one of three (HP section 2, CA-3).
Wire form: `{"request": <request_id>}`, `"bootstrap"` or `"autonomous"`.

HostResult.description: Hub to plugin: the Hub's answer (HP CA-2, CA-5). `effect` describes that call only (HP ER-5).
